songs.scriptText:
VERSE 1:
Benedictus sit Deus Pater, unigenitusque Dei Filius, sanctus quoque Spiritus:
quia fecit nobiscum misericordiam suam.
songs.title: Benedictus Sit Deus Pater
Panis Angelicus
songs.scriptText:
VERSE 1 (Latin):
Panis angelicus fit panis hominum;
Dat panis coelicus figuris terminum:
O res mirabilis! Manducat Dominum
Pauper, servus et humilis.

songs.title: K’anyi Kelenu Virgin Maria
songs.scriptText:
STANZA 1:
K’anyi kelenu Virgin Maria, Nne nke Chukwu,
Onye amuru n’ebughi ajo njo mbido.
Nne mara mma, Nne di aso,
Biko riori anyi aririo n’iru Chukwu Dinwenu.

CHORUS:
Ave, Ave, Maria!
Ave, Ave, Maria!

announcements.title: Solemnity of Christ the King & St. Cecilia Patronal Feast Preparation
announcements.messageBody: All choristers are reminded that special full-choir rehearsals commence this week ahead of our annual patronal feast and robing ceremonies. Attendance is strictly compulsory.
